theorems.DAG: every escape edge raises SHELL by exactly one; hence the directed escape graph is acyclic
theorems.geodesic_equivalence: escape paths are exactly the dual-graph paths whose shell increases by one at every jump, equivalently geodesic continuations away from STAR(O_E)
theorems.single_seed_shell: a seed cell of shell s has every exact-J endpoint on shell s+J
theorems.aggregate_exact_endpoints: for the full one-step D6 incidence seed set B_2, END_J=S_J union S_(J+1) union S_(J+2) for every J>=0
theorems.all_shell_cells_reachable: yes for the aggregate one-step D6 seed set on every shell admitted by the previous two identities
theorems.branching: odd-shell cells have two equally far outward successors, so no canonical single path exists
theorems.merging: distinct escape branches can recoalesce; aggregate branch mergers occur from J=2 onward
theorems.canonicality: the full path family and reachable endpoint sets are canonical after the carrier, origin-star and graph-distance score are frozen; no tie selection is required

proof_skeleton: dual-graph distance changes by at most one across an edge
the explicit shell certificate shows every cell has at least one shell+1 neighbor, with branch count 1 on even shells and 2 on odd shells
therefore FAR is exactly the outward-neighbor relation
the six one-step endpoint incident-cell families have geometric union B_2
every cell of positive shell has an inward predecessor, so reversing an inward geodesic supplies reachability from the appropriate seed shell
